visual_thesis: A paper claim, its code and its outputs can be checked against each other. Peer critique and reruns can expose weak claims, but file agreement does not prove experimental validity.
mechanism_metaphor: A continuous radial paper-relief commons rather than separate cards. A central open research bundle exposes three clearly distinct front leaves labeled Paper, Code and Data. Their physical paper tabs align at a shared seam. On the left a folded peer-review margin with two source-linked critique notches connects to a revised claim leaf. On the right the data leaf reaches an opened rerun sleeve containing a paired original-output shape and matching replay shape, joined by a headless comparison brace. A second, mismatched hypothesis fold is visibly withdrawn into a retracted-claim pocket, explicitly labeled Retract weak claims. Null-result leaf remains visible and labeled Null results count. Twelve meaningful roles: manuscript leaf, code leaf, data leaf, claim seam, critique margin, two critique notches with distinct geometry, revised leaf, original output, replay output, comparison brace, withdrawal fold and null leaf. Abstract shapes encode compared artifacts, never measured quantities or code text. No people, lab buildings, robot agents, fake writing or numeric graph.
story_anchors: Peer critique seam and withdrawn claim fold
Paired output rerun comparison and visible null-result leaf
required_labels: Files can agree; methods can fail

source_claim_map.proposition: Studies deposit manuscript, experimental code, output artifacts and claim ledgers.
Peer critique led to revisions and public retractions before publication.
Audits establish saved-output agreement rather than upstream experimental validity.

excluded_claims: No people, faces, avatars, humanoids, logos, photorealism, scenic props, generic dashboards, panel collages, decorative machinery, fake writing, unlisted text or symbols, invented controls, measured ratios or unsupported causal arrows. Background white. Keep every foreground component and all glyph extents at least 60px inside where feasible and always at least 40px; plan caveats above y560.

Recompose them into ONE CONTINUOUS RADIAL PAPER ASSEMBLY around the shared central binding. Remove the large separate green backing boards: there must be no left panel/right panel collage. Remove cream caption plaques for Peer critique, Rerun outputs, Null results count and the caveat; print these exact captions directly on open white space in dark brown. Paper, Code and Data remain printed directly on their own substantive front leaves. Put the matched output shapes on one small folded output sheet with a plain headless comparison brace. Keep the critique arrow ending inside the retracted-claim pocket and one data-to-rerun arrow touching the actual folded sheet. No other arrows. MOST IMPORTANT: keep EVERY foreground pixel inside x90..1110 and y70..555 at1200x630, leaving a BROAD visible WHITE BORDER all around.
